sql_calls.sql:
SELECT MIN(date), MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales;
SELECT MIN(bill_ts), MAX(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines;

SELECT 'daily_sales' AS t, MIN(date)::text AS mn, MAX(date)::text AS mx FROM store.daily_sales
UNION ALL SELECT 'pos_lines', MIN(bill_ts)::text, MAX(bill_ts)::text FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'shelf_audits', MIN(audit_ts)::text, MAX(audit_ts)::text FROM store.shelf_audits
UNION ALL SELECT 'stock_counts', MIN(count_ts)::text, MAX(count_ts)::text FROM store.stock_counts
UNION ALL SELECT 'inventory_book', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text FROM store.inventory_book
UNION ALL SELECT 'forecasts', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text FROM store.forecasts
UNION ALL SELECT 'write_offs', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text FROM store.write_offs
UNION ALL SELECT 'goods_receipts', MIN(received_ts)::text, MAX(received_ts)::text FROM store.goods_receipts
UNION ALL SELECT 'fresh_deliveries', MIN(delivery_ts)::text, MAX(delivery_ts)::text FROM store.fresh_deliveries;

SELECT date, sku, units_sold, revenue_inr
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= '2026-06-01' AND date <= '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY date;

SELECT bill_ts::date AS d, gtin_scanned, sku_scanned, SUM(qty) AS qty, COUNT(*) AS lines
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
  AND (gtin_scanned = '2900001001014' OR sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG')
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 1;
SELECT DISTINCT gtin_scanned, sku_scanned FROM store.pos_lines ORDER BY 1,2;

SELECT SUM(units_sold) AS total_units, SUM(revenue_inr) AS total_rev, COUNT(*) AS days_with_sales
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= '2026-06-01' AND date <= '2026-06-30';

SELECT SUM(qty) AS pos_total_units
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
  AND gtin_scanned = '2900001001014';

SELECT audit_ts::date AS d, sku, status, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 1;

FROM store.stock_counts
